title: Explorer, villager, town planner
subtitle: The test: What do you care about? What makes you lose your sense of time? All three are brilliant.
alt: Three columns. The explorer is bursting with ideas, sees failure as just an experiment, makes a prototype for early adopters, and reads explorer coding and building fast with agents first. The villager loves the user, does not like failure that much, packages and releases, and reads shipping, selling and your own newsroom first. The town planner geeks out on the details, likes to be invisible, makes something a commodity, and reads controlling your agent, the record, serverless for real and reading code as a graph first.
